name: nlp_distil_bert
title: BERT -> 4-layer student distillation done correctly: a frozen no-grad teacher, a KD loss over logits, a per-batch warmup schedule and an eval() + no_grad() validation pass
origin: hardening round 2, domain-nlp, 2026-09-14 - the two-model shape (teacher + student) round 1 never built
note: The correct twin of nlp_distil_bert_bad. Zero findings in both dataflow modes on 2026-09-14. The reason this program is in the corpus is the teacher: it is a second nn.Module in the same workspace that is legitimately left in eval() and wrapped in @torch.no_grad(), which is exactly the configuration that must not make MLView quiet about the student (and, today, does - see nlp_distil_bert_bad's MLV301 row).

forbidden.why: evaluate() calls student.eval() on its first line (line 67)
evaluate() carries the @torch.no_grad() decorator (line 65) and teacher_logits carries its own (losses.py line 38)
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is called before every forward (line 53)
optimizer.step() runs on line 59, after loss.backward() on line 57
loss.backward() (line 57) precedes optimizer.step() (line 59)
the only no_grad regions are the teacher forward and evaluate(), neither of which back-propagates
the running loss accumulates loss.item() (line 61), a Python float
get_linear_schedule_with_warmup is a per-batch schedule and scheduler.step() runs inside the batch loop (line 60)
clip_grad_norm_ sits between backward (57) and step (59), which is the only correct position
logits.argmax(dim=-1) on line 74 turns the logits into class ids before f1_score sees them
self.hard is given the raw student logits (line 23 forward signature, line 24 call); the only softmax in the file is the KL term's, which is what KLDivLoss requires
no sigmoid and no BCE loss appear in this project
the training loader passes shuffle=True (line 37)
the evaluation loader passes shuffle=False explicitly (line 39)
neither DataLoader takes num_workers=, and main() is reached only through the __main__ guard (line 106)
every batch goes through move(batch, device) (lines 51 and 71) before the forward, and move() is a workspace function whose body is a .to(device) comprehension
pick_device() guards on torch.cuda.is_available() (line 31)
seed_everything() seeds random, numpy, torch and CUDA (lines 24-27) and is the first statement of main()
no split call exists in this project; the encoded DatasetDict arrives already split
both nn.Module subclasses call super().__init__() (lines 12 and 31)
every submodule is assigned directly to an attribute; no plain list or dict of modules exists
torch.save is given student.state_dict() (line 102) and nothing calls torch.load

unsupported.defect: none - the best checkpoint is selected on the validation macro-F1, which is correct
unsupported.why: MLV802 is a later-tier rule and is not built, so the correct shape cannot be scored either

unsupported.defect: none - the T^2 rescaling is Hinton's correction and is present
unsupported.why: no rule models the temperature scaling of a distillation objective
